name: Capture of Goma
detail: M23, with Rwandan special-forces support per UN experts, seized Goma on Jan 27, 2025 after cutting the city's two access roads — the war's single deadliest event, with UN estimates near 3,000 dead.

name: Capture of Bukavu
detail: M23 took the South Kivu capital on Feb 16, 2025 with almost no FARDC resistance, extending rebel control over both Kivu provincial capitals.

name: Capture of Walikale
detail: M23's furthest westward advance of the campaign, taken Mar 19-20, 2025 after seizing Kashebere and Kibati.

name: Seizure of Kalehe Mineral Towns
detail: M23 took the cassiterite trading towns of Nyabibwe, Numbi and Lumbishi in Kalehe territory, South Kivu, expanding control over tin-ore supply chains.

name: Capture of Uvira
detail: AFC/M23's biggest advance since February 2025 — the Lake Tanganyika port fell Dec 10, 2025 after fighting for Sange, Luberizi, Luvungi and Kamanyola, in direct breach of the Doha ceasefire.

name: Rubaya Coltan Taxation Regime
detail: Since seizing Rubaya in April 2024, M23 has taxed roughly 120 tonnes/month of coltan trade at ~15% of value, earning at least $800,000/month — the conflict's core financing mechanism.

name: M23 Counteroffensive in Masisi
detail: After FARDC-Wazalendo forces retook villages around Katoyi in Feb 2026, M23 pushed back near Kashovu and Lumbishi and recaptured lost ground within days, collapsing the Angolan ceasefire proposal.

name: M23 Expels Verification Mechanism Member
detail: M23 expelled a Congolese government representative from the joint ceasefire verification mechanism even as a prisoner exchange proceeded, undercutting the Washington/Doha monitoring architecture.
